script.title: Piplup — A Little Wave
script.description: A large, rounded Piplup greeting you with one raised flipper. An oversized navy head, curved white face mask, sparkling eyes, golden beak, twin chest spots, webbed feet and forked tail surround a connected hollow structure.

check.health: warning: 996 parts with verified connectors form 58 separately connected groups; 33 parts are not connected to anything. 136 parts have no verified connector data (custom, tilted or not yet verified); they may join these groups.
